versions.content: BS states the block size (the number of CFs between the Flow Control frames). If no acknowledgement is configured, all values from 0x00 to 0xFF are valid whereas 0x00 indicates that no more flow control shall take place and the rest of the pending message will be transmitted within one big block. Otherwise, only the values 0x01 – 0x10 are valid.
